title: JWT Authentication & Authorization Guidelines
keyTechniques: Verify Bearer token format in standard Authorization headers ('Authorization: Bearer <token>')
Store secret keys in process.env.JWT_SECRET with fallback for local dev
Return 401 Unauthorized for missing/invalid tokens and 403 Forbidden for insufficient permissions
Attach parsed token payload (req.user) to Express request objects for route handlers
avoid: Do not log JWT secrets or raw tokens in server logs
Do not ignore token expiration (exp claim) verification
